decisions.reason: As a close-to-core design variant with low incremental carrying cost, it is likely to stay because any modest shortfall versus aspiration can be tolerated within the firm's portfolio slack.

This shower channel fits the firm's core barrier-free drainage business, so unless its second-year results are clearly below aspiration management would usually retain it and continue learning from the launch.

A tileable floor drain with grating is a very natural extension of the established range, making retention more likely than withdrawal absent obvious underperformance versus internal and peer-based aspirations.
The stainless steel design grate complements the existing offer at relatively low organisational cost, which gives management room to keep it while rounding out the design-led portfolio.

Because the earlier withdrawal of Product C raises scrutiny of pump-assisted concepts, F faces a materially higher exit risk, but as a newer and more focused shower-channel application it is still worth keeping for another evaluation period.
